A '''double-barreled laser cannon''' was a [[laser cannon]] with two barrels that could be carried by an individual. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] once carried one of these [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]].
